actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.fathom_get_recording_summary.des: Gets the AI summary of one recording by its recording ID. Built for AI agents.
actions.fathom_get_recording_summary.pro: The numeric recording_id from New Recording or List Meetings.
Gets the transcript of one recording by its recording ID. Built for AI agents.
The numeric recording_id from New Recording or List Meetings.
actions.fathom_list_meetings.description: Returns one page of Fathom meetings with optional filters. Built for AI agents.
actions.fathom_list_meetings.props.calen: Company domains of the invitees, exact match (e.g. acme.com).
Only internal meetings, or only meetings with at least one external invitee.
actions.fathom_list_meetings.props.creat: Only meetings created after this ISO 8601 date-time.
Only meetings created before this ISO 8601 date-time.
actions.fathom_list_meetings.props.meeti: Exact meeting type name from List Meeting Types. An unknown name returns no meetings.
actions.fathom_list_meetings.props.recor: Emails of the Fathom users who recorded the meetings.
actions.findTeam.description: List the teams in your Fathom account, one page at a time.
actions.findTeamMember.description: List the members of your Fathom account, optionally only those of one team. To look up one person, use Find Team Member by Email.
actions.find_team_member_by_email.descri: Look up one Fathom team member by their exact email address.
Email address of the member, e.g. jane@acme.com.
Optional exact team name to search within.
actions.getRecordingSummary.description: Get the AI-generated summary of a meeting recording. Works with both OAuth and API key connections.
actions.getRecordingSummary.props.destin: Optional: URL where Fathom will POST the summary. Leave empty to get data directly in response.
actions.getRecordingSummary.props.record: Select the meeting recording to get the summary for
actions.getRecordingTranscript.descripti: Get the transcript of a meeting recording. Works with both OAuth and API key connections.
actions.getRecordingTranscript.props.des: Optional: URL where Fathom will POST the transcript. Leave empty to get data directly in response.
actions.getRecordingTranscript.props.rec: Select the meeting recording to get the transcript for
actions.get_recording_download.descripti: Check a download started with Request Recording Download and get the file link once it is ready.
actions.get_recording_download.props.dow: The download_id returned by Request Recording Download.
actions.get_recording_download.props.rec: The numeric recording_id the download was requested for.
actions.listMeetings.description: List meetings with optional filters. Follows every page unless you set Max Pages.
actions.listMeetings.props.calendar_invi: Email addresses of calendar invitees to filter by. Fathom no longer documents this filter and may ignore it; prefer Calendar Invitees Domains or Recorded By.
Domains of the companies to filter by (e.g., acme.com)
Filter by whether calendar invitee list includes external email domains
actions.listMeetings.props.created_after: Filter to meetings created after this timestamp (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)
actions.listMeetings.props.created_befor: Filter to meetings created before this timestamp (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)
actions.listMeetings.props.include_actio: Include the action items for each meeting
actions.listMeetings.props.include_crm_m: Include CRM matches for each meeting
actions.listMeetings.props.include_summa: Include the summary for each meeting. API key connections only; with OAuth use Get Recording Summary.
actions.listMeetings.props.include_trans: Include the transcript for each meeting. API key connections only; with OAuth use Get Recording Transcript.
actions.listMeetings.props.max_pages.des: Stop after this many pages of meetings. Leave empty to fetch every page (each page holds about 10 meetings).
actions.listMeetings.props.recorded_by.d: Email addresses of users who recorded meetings
actions.listMeetings.props.teams.descrip: Team names to filter by (e.g., Sales, Engineering)
actions.list_meeting_types.description: List the meeting types defined in your Fathom organization.
Active types can be assigned to new meetings; inactive ones only appear on older meetings.
actions.list_users.description: List the users of your Fathom account with their status and permissions. Needs an account admin connection.
actions.list_users.props.settings_access: Filter by settings access. Not available together with Status = Invited.
actions.list_users.props.team.descriptio: Exact team name to filter by (see Find Team).
actions.request_recording_download.descr: Ask Fathom to prepare a video or audio file of a recording. Then use Get Recording Download to get the file link.
actions.request_recording_download.props: The numeric recording_id from New Recording or List Meetings.
description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, highlights, and generates AI summaries and action items from your meetings. Integrate with workflows to react to meeting events and retrieve meeting data.
triggers.newRecording.description: Fires when Fathom finishes processing a new meeting recording. Turn on at least one of the Include options.
triggers.newRecording.props.include_acti: Include the action items in the webhook payload
triggers.newRecording.props.include_crm_: Include CRM matches in the webhook payload
triggers.newRecording.props.include_summ: Include the summary in the webhook payload. Fathom needs at least one Include option turned on.
triggers.newRecording.props.include_tran: Include the transcript in the webhook payload
triggers.newRecording.props.triggered_fo: Select which types of recordings should trigger this webhook
